# Merchant

[All quest chapters](index.md)

<a id="q-7d70e73d9b1a61ac"></a>

## Become a Merchant

Gild Tesoro started as a slave and ended up owning a city made of gold.

Choose Merchant as one of your professions.

**Tasks**

- Choose Merchant

**Rewards**

- Doriki +60, Belly +2,000, Merchant XP +300

<a id="q-3297d8a432dc93c7"></a>

## Apprentice Merchant

Buy low, sell high, deliver on time.

Reach Merchant level 5.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Become a Merchant](merchant.md#q-7d70e73d9b1a61ac)

**Tasks**

- Reach Merchant level 5

**Rewards**

- Doriki +120, Belly +6,000, Merchant XP +800

<a id="q-1a1102427fe5e65c"></a>

## Journeyman Merchant

Sabaody's auction house sells anything to anyone. Sell a lot of your own there.

Reach Merchant level 25 and complete the tasks below.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Apprentice Merchant](merchant.md#q-3297d8a432dc93c7)

**Tasks**

- Reach Merchant level 25
- Sell a lot at the Auction House
- Land on the Sabaody Archipelago

**Rewards**

- Doriki +240, Belly +25,000, Merchant XP +3,000

<a id="q-766871c0b27549c9"></a>

## Expert Merchant

Decipher a treasure map, dig, and then do it again with a legendary one.

Reach Merchant level 50 and complete the tasks below.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Journeyman Merchant](merchant.md#q-1a1102427fe5e65c)

**Tasks**

- Reach Merchant level 50
- Dig up a deciphered treasure
- Dig up a legendary treasure

**Rewards**

- Doriki +480, Belly +70,000, Merchant XP +7,000, New World Crate

<a id="q-543317dd3a9a8996"></a>

## Master Merchant

A merchant who owns the market wears the Golden Emperor's title.

Reach Merchant level 100 and earn the title.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Expert Merchant](merchant.md#q-766871c0b27549c9)

**Tasks**

- Reach Merchant level 100

**Rewards**

- Doriki +900, Belly +250,000, Legendary Crate
